faq_items.question: What is Google doing to make AI more private?
faq_items.answer: Google is using homomorphic encryption to make private AI practical, ensuring data privacy while still allowing computations on it.

faq_items.question: What does "AI by Hand" refer to in the news?
faq_items.answer: "AI by Hand" likely refers to a project or initiative focusing on developing AI models through manual, human-guided processes rather than relying solely on large datasets and automated learning.
